_comment: 대주 (stock-loan) availability, maintained by the operator.
WHY A FILE. Three KIS 대주 endpoints were guessed and all three disproven by
read-only probes against the live account on 2026-08-02:
TTTC8909R /inquire-credit-psamount -> reports 융자 (margin BUY) power, wrong question
CTSC0271R /credit-by-company       -> '잘못된 TR 코드 입니다', no such TR
CTRP6504R /inquire-credit-balance  -> HTTP 404, no such path
Guessing a fourth would repeat the mistake, and a wrong-but-successful response
would be worse than a failure. For a retail account the 대주 list is checked on the
broker's web UI anyway, so this file is an honest primary source.
TO USE: copy to config/borrow_availability.json and keep observed_at current.
observed_at IS MANDATORY and applies to the whole file. It is what makes the normal
freshness rule work: a file left over from yesterday goes stale on the same clock a
live query would, instead of being trusted because it is local. A file without it is
refused outright — an undated locate cannot be point-in-time evaluated, and stamping
it 'now' is the same look-ahead leak the shadow evaluator exists to prevent.
Default staleness ceiling is 30s (config/short_risk_policy.yaml ->
borrow.max_snapshot_age_seconds). A hand-maintained file will therefore go stale
almost immediately, which is CORRECT: it means a hand-maintained locate is not good
enough to place a real short against. Raise the ceiling deliberately if you accept
that trade-off for shadow evaluation, and understand that you are widening the
window in which the locate could have disappeared.
A symbol absent from 'symbols' is UNANSWERED, not unavailable — no snapshot is
produced at all, which every consumer reads as no-locate.
fee_bps_annualised is an ANNUALISED rate in basis points (8%/yr = 800), matching
what a broker quotes. The system pro-rates it over the actual holding period. A
missing fee is NOT free: it fails the cost gate.
